evidence.value: carnivore
evidence.quote: As stated, Pacman Frogs are opportunistic carnivores. Crickets, earthworms, and roaches comprise their primary diet.

evidence.value: Grillons, vers de terre et blattes
evidence.quote: Crickets, earthworms, and roaches comprise their primary diet. They can also occasionally eat mealworms, ants, mites, and larger prey such as snakes, baby mice, and other frogs. If you primarily feed insects to your Pacman Frog, they should eat every day.

evidence.value: Souriceaux (pinkies)
evidence.quote: Although adult Pacman Frogs can fit a pinkie in their cavernous mouths, only offer these small mice as treats, since they are high in fat and can cause your pet to quickly pack on excess weight.

evidence.value: Souriceaux (pinkies) en aliment régulier

evidence.value: daily

evidence.value: Compléter l'alimentation avec un supplément de calcium et un multivitamine adaptés aux grenouilles.

evidence.value: Chytridiomycose

evidence.value: Dépistage par PCR (écouvillon cutané) des animaux à risque, notamment lors du transport ou de la quarantaine.
evidence.quote: Real-time PCR assay performed on swabs of the integument or pieces of skin is diagnostic and provides rapid assessment of presence and quantity of zoospores. evidence.value: Saprolegniose
evidence.quote: Saprolegniasis refers to disease caused by several genera of opportunistic fungi or water molds that infect the gills and skin of aquatic and larval amphibians.

evidence.value: Croissance blanchâtre, cotonneuse sur la peau, typiquement sur une ancienne lésion ; léthargie, détresse respiratoire, anorexie.
evidence.quote: Affected animals have a whitish, cotton-like growth on their skin, typically at the site of previous trauma such as abarasions.

evidence.value: La perte du mucus protecteur causée par des irritants chimiques (désinfectants, savons, détergents), des pics d'ammoniaque et la malnutrition (surtout la carence en vitamine A) peut favoriser la maladie.
evidence.quote: Removal of the slime layer due to chemical irritants such as disinfectants, soaps, detergents, or ammonia spikes and malnutrition, especially hypovitaminosis A, may also contribute to formation.

evidence.value: Syndrome de la patte rouge (dermatosepticémie bactérienne)

evidence.value: Grenouille terrestre et nocturne qui chasse à l'affût ; elle passe l'essentiel de son temps enterrée dans son substrat en attendant une proie.
evidence.quote: Tomato Frogs are terrestrial, nocturnal ambush hunters. They spend most of their time burrowed in their substrate, waiting for unsuspecting prey to cross their path.

evidence.value: semi-grégaire
evidence.quote: You can house multiple Tomato Frogs together, but we recommend that you provide a minimum of 10 gallons of aquarium space for each Tomato Frog that you’re housing .

evidence.value: débutant
evidence.quote: Tomato Frogs are relatively popular as pets thanks to their bright coloration, confident demeanor, cute faces, small space requirements, and simple husbandry.

evidence.value: Plusieurs grenouilles tomates peuvent cohabiter (au moins 10 gallons par individu) ; les mâles peuvent se battre en période de reproduction.
evidence.quote: You can house multiple Tomato Frogs together, but we recommend that you provide a minimum of 10 gallons of aquarium space for each Tomato Frog that you’re housing . Males may engage in combat if mating season conditions are present

evidence.value: Maladie osseuse métabolique
evidence.quote: MBD, or metabolic bone disease , is caused by an improper dietary calcium: phosphorus ratio .

evidence.value: Os fins et fragiles, léthargie, perte d'appétit, déformations de croissance.
evidence.quote: Common symptoms of MBD include (but aren’t limited to)… Thinning, brittle bone structure Lethargy Lack of appetite Various growth deformities

evidence.value: Donner des insectes riches en calcium (gavés) ou saupoudrer les proies de poudre de calcium.
evidence.quote: one of the easiest way to avoid MBD is to feed calcium-rich, gut-loaded insects or dust feeder insects with calcium powder.

evidence.value: Déshydratation
evidence.quote: Having permeable skin, amphibians are extremely prone to dehydration.

evidence.value: Si l'habitat se dessèche, la grenouille se déshydrate très vite, en quelques heures.
evidence.quote: If their habitat is allowed to dry out, they will become dehydrated quite fast – within hours.

evidence.value: Vérifier chaque jour l'humidité et l'humidité du substrat.
evidence.quote: It’s essential to check the humidity and substrate moisture daily to prevent dehydration in your Tomato Frog.

evidence.value: Exposition aux produits chimiques
evidence.quote: Again, due to their permeable skin, Tomato Frogs are quite sensitive to pollutants and chemicals.

evidence.value: Se laver les mains avant de manipuler la grenouille et remplir sa gamelle d'eau déchlorée ; ne pas donner d'insectes sauvages (risque d'insecticides).
evidence.quote: You should always wash your hands if you need to handle your Tomato Frog and be sure that you are filling its dish with dechlorinated water. Another common source of poisoning is wild insects from outside, which could already be poisoned by insecticides.

evidence.value: Infections fongiques
evidence.quote: Moisture and warmth create a breeding ground for fungi, unfortunately, including harmful strains that can cause infections.

evidence.value: Changer le substrat et nettoyer l'enclos chaque mois ; éviter que la litière devienne marécageuse.
evidence.quote: You can help to prevent fungal infections by changing the substrate and cleaning the enclosure every month . Be sure to prevent the bedding from becoming ‘swampy,’ as well.

evidence.value: terrarium
evidence.quote: if you plan on putting together a bioactive terrarium with live plants, you will want 5-6″ of substrate

evidence.quote: Just like supplemental heating, supplemental lighting is not required for Tomato Frogs. Still, recent studies prove time and again that UVB lighting has positive impacts on blood serum Vitamin D3 levels in reptiles, and the same is likely true for amphibians.

evidence.quote: You can enrich your pet’s life by recreating these opportunities in captivity with half-log hides, rocks, caves, cork bark, leaf litter, fake plants, and other low-lying, amphibian-safe decorations.

evidence.value: Utiliser de l'eau déchlorée, car les amphibiens absorbent l'eau par la peau.
evidence.quote: It’s also vital that you use dechlorinated water because amphibians absorb water through their skin – and that includes any harmful chemicals in the water.
